blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Douglas Michael Mallillin was nominated as the new chairperson of Commission on Audit (COA), according to the Commission on Appointments (CA) pending nominations. The CA received Mallillin’s nomination on Nov. 16. Mallillin was appointed as ad interim Commissioner of COA on February 10, 2025. Prior to this he was Director IV under the agency’s Office of the Chairperson. His nomination is pending confirmation of the CA. /ms...
